verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the public Expensify/App GitHub repo, which documents installing dependencies and running the app locally (`npm install`, `npm run web`), so some first-party code can be built and run on your own machine. Nothing shows that the backend or core service can be self-hosted. The rest of the pack describes Expensify as a hosted SaaS with cloud API credentials and OAuth. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the backend/core service, deployment guide for production self-hosting, evidence the app runs independently of Expensify's cloud, independent corroboration.
